findings.text: The outbound submission convenience accepts a single scatter element plus a caller token and delegates to the shared insertion logic with one output segment and no input segments.
The broken queue probe translates a generic queue reference to its ring specific form and reports the cached failure indication through one atomic read.
Sixteen bit host to device conversion selects little endian or big endian encoding according to negotiated device endianness and returns a virtio typed value.

Hypervisor console creation lazily initializes the subsystem when required, allocates a variable length object, records terminal identity plus opaque data plus operations plus output capacity, initializes port state plus resize work plus lock, selects an index by reusing a matching slot or first free slot or monotonic overflow, updates shared tables only for static slots, links the object globally and evaluates kernel console registration.

Deferred resize stores a supplied window size into the console object and schedules terminal size propagation work, with a wrapper that serializes the store under the object lock while preserving interrupt state.

Console presence testing acquires the console list guard, checks list linkage as the registration indicator, releases the guard and returns the result, with lock validation empty in this configuration.

Input discard does nothing once the device reference is clear. Otherwise it repeatedly collects pending receive buffers, adds each unread remainder to counter bytes_discarded, tries to return every buffer to the receive queue while clearing the cached pointer, releases failures immediately and warns when any return failed.

Presence testing refreshes cached member inbuf from the completion path while holding guard inbuf_lock with interrupt state preserved and reports availability exactly when a buffer remains after refresh.

Control transmission does nothing on single port devices. Otherwise it serializes shared member cpkt plus queue c_ovq under guard c_ovq_lock, fills fields id plus event plus value with endian converted forms, submits the packet as one outbound element with atomic allocation, notifies the peer and busy waits with relaxation for completion unless the queue reports broken, always reporting success.
Per port control forwarding proceeds only while the device reference remains set and otherwise silently reports success, covering unplug races before close.
Output reclamation does nothing once the device reference is clear. Otherwise it drains every completed outbound completion, releases each associated buffer and clears flag outvq_full.

Shared transmission samples the device reference atomically under guard outvq_lock, abandons with zero progress on unplug or power freeze indicated by member pm_freezing, otherwise reclaims completions, submits the caller scatter set with atomic allocation, notifies the peer, sets flag outvq_full when no free descriptors remain, spins with relaxation for completion or broken status for blocking callers and finally accounts member bytes_sent before returning progress.

Transmission buffer ownership releases the caller buffer on submission failure and on early unplug or freeze exits, releases the returned completion after a blocking wait and leaves the buffer attached when the queue is broken so teardown can detach it later.

Shared reading returns zero for empty requests or absent data, truncates to the unread remainder of cached member inbuf using fields len and offset, copies to user space with fault error EFAULT or to kernel memory directly, advances offset and when fully consumed clears the cache and returns the buffer to queue in_vq with a warning on failure, returning the copied length.

Read blocking is false after guest flag guest_connected clears and otherwise requires both missing data and host flag host_connected set. Write blocking is false after guest disconnect, true without host connection and otherwise equals reclaimed flag outvq_full sampled under guard outvq_lock.

File reading reports error ENODEV when flag guest_connected is clear, returns zero when empty and host flag host_connected is clear, reports error EAGAIN for nonblocking empty reads, sleeps freezably on queue waitqueue until readable, rechecks guest presence after wake, prefers delivering newly arrived data over reporting host loss and delegates to shared reading in user copy mode.

Writability waiting sleeps freezably while the write predicate holds unless flag O_NONBLOCK is set and then reports error ENODEV on guest disconnect. File writing ignores empty counts, enforces writability, caps transfers at thirty two kibibytes, stages user bytes into a fresh buffer with errors ENOMEM and EFAULT on allocation or copy failure and submits through shared transmission with a single scatter element in nonblocking mode.

Splice staging holds member n for used entries plus member size for capacity plus member len for total bytes plus member sg pointing to the scatter array, used to collect pipe pages before one queue submission.

Pipe mapping stops with zero when used count reaches capacity, otherwise it prefers stealing the pipe page with an added reference or falls back to allocating plus copying into a fresh page bounded by page size with offset handling, installs the result into the next scatter slot and advances both entry count and byte total by the mapped length, reporting allocation error ENOMEM on failure.

Splice writing reports error EINVAL on remote processor serial transports, requires a nonempty pipe under pipe guard, enforces writability with nonblocking awareness, sizes a buffer by pipe occupancy, initializes a scatter table, extracts content through the pipe mapping callback and on positive extraction submits one nonblocking transmission while otherwise releasing the buffer.

Polling registers queue waitqueue, reports hangup alone when flag guest_connected is clear, otherwise marks readable when the read predicate is false and writable when the write predicate is false while adding hangup whenever flag host_connected is clear.

Generic open fails with error ENXIO on missing device or console port, fails with error EBUSY when flag guest_connected is already set, otherwise sets the flag under guard inbuf_lock, reclaims stale completions, announces open with value one and releases the reference on failure. Release announces close with value zero, clears the flag, discards input under the input guard, reclaims output under the output guard and drops the reference.

The generic file table under module ownership binds open to handler port_fops_open plus read to handler port_fops_read plus write to handler port_fops_write plus splice write to handler port_fops_splice_write plus poll to handler port_fops_poll plus release to handler port_fops_release plus asynchronous notification to handler port_fops_fasync.

Console output reports error EPIPE on unknown terminal number, returns the full requested count without action on unplug or power freeze to avoid retry loops, otherwise stages bytes into an atomic buffer with error ENOMEM on allocation failure and transfers ownership to shared transmission in blocking mode.
Console input reports error EPIPE on unknown terminal number, requires member in_vq to exist and delegates to shared reading in kernel copy mode.

Console resizing ignores null references and non console ports, skips feature probing on remote processor transports and otherwise forwards stored member ws when feature VIRTIO_CONSOLE_F_SIZE is negotiated.

Guard inbuf_lock with interrupt state preserved protects cached member inbuf plus flag guest_connected across presence testing plus read recycling plus single opener transitions plus discard and release paths.

Guard outvq_lock with interrupt state preserved protects submission plus flag outvq_full plus atomic sampling of device reference and member pm_freezing, keeping freeze checking atomic with insertion relative to removal and serializing reclamation during writability probing plus open plus release.
Guard c_ovq_lock serializes construction of shared member cpkt plus submission plus completion polling on queue c_ovq for control messages.

Console resizing uses member lock of the console object, allocation uses global mutex hvc_structs_mutex for list plus slot tables, port console linking uses driver lock pdrvdata_lock and registration checks use the console list guard with paired acquire and release.

Console indexing first reuses a slot matching both terminal identity and operations, otherwise takes the first free slot and otherwise overflows beyond the static table with a monotonic counter while only static slots update shared tables vtermnos and cons_ops.
Kernel console registration is skipped when already registered and otherwise proceeds only when the allocated index equals the requested console index.

The console operations table binds character input to handler get_chars plus character output to handler put_chars plus addition notification to handler notifier_add_vio plus removal notification to handler notifier_del_vio plus hangup notification also to handler notifier_del_vio.

Console port setup allocates a terminal number with minimum one, creates a hypervisor console with output capacity PAGE_SIZE, reports allocation failures with cleanup of both terminal number and console object, links the console list under driver guard, sets flag guest_connected and announces open with value one.

Addition notification reports error EINVAL on unknown terminal mapping, otherwise marks member irq_requested as requested and attempts resize. Removal and hangup share handling that merely clears member irq_requested.

Control and blocking data transmission busy wait with processor relaxation until peer completion or broken queue indication, so callers must avoid sleeping locks in these paths and must tolerate extended spinning when the peer stalls without breaking the queue.

Recycling plus control plus console output run under spinlocks with atomic allocation while generic write plus splice allocate sleepably after waiting, with user copy faults plus allocation failures plus unsupported transports reported without queue mutation.
Control packets carry field id as thirty two bit plus field event as sixteen bit plus field value as sixteen bit in device negotiated endianness.
Port open announcements use constant VIRTIO_CONSOLE_PORT_OPEN with value one for open and value zero for close, and console size negotiation uses constant VIRTIO_CONSOLE_F_SIZE.

Readiness uses constants EPOLLIN plus EPOLLRDNORM for readable plus EPOLLOUT for writable plus EPOLLHUP for hangup, generic writes cap at thirty two kibibytes and console creation uses output capacity PAGE_SIZE.
Asynchronous notification setup forwards descriptor state to the generic helper bound to per port member async_queue.
Registration state follows list node linkage with the console list guard held, and lock validation does nothing in this configuration.
